name: Build macOS Binary

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python for uv
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6.7.0

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5

          --exclude-module=rlcompleter \
          --exclude-module=runpy \

          --exclude-module=secrets \

          --exclude-module=selectors \

          --exclude-module=sysconfig \
          --exclude-module=tabnanny \
          --exclude-module=tarfile \
          --exclude-module=telnetlib \
          --exclude-module=tempfile \
          --exclude-module=textwrap \
          --exclude-module=threading \
          --exclude-module=timeit \
          --exclude-module=tkinter \
          --exclude-module=tomllib \
          --exclude-module=token \
          --exclude-module=tokenize \
          --exclude-module=trace \
          --exclude-module=traceback \
          --exclude-module=tracemalloc \
          --exclude-module/tty \
          --exclude-module=turtle \
          --exclude-module=turtledemo \
          --exclude-module=types \
          --exclude-module=typing \
          --exclude-module=unicodedata \
          --exclude-module=unittest \
          --exclude-module=urllib \
          --exclude-module=usercustomize \
          --exclude-module=uu \
          --exclude-module=uuid \
          --exclude-module=venv \
          --exclude-module=wave \
          --exclude-module=weakref \
          --exclude-module=warnings \
          --exclude-module=webbrowser \
          --exclude-module=winreg \
          --exclude-module=winsound \
          --exclude-module=xml \
          --exclude-module=xmlrpc \
          --exclude-module=zipapp \
          --exclude-module=zipfile \
          --exclude-module=zipimport \
          --exclude-module=zlib \
          a2ascanner/cli.py

    - name: Create tar.gz archive
      run: |
        cd dist
        tar -czf a2a-scanner-macos-arm64.tar.gz a2a-scanner

    - name: Upload binary to release
      uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
        asset_path: ./dist/a2a-scanner-macos-arm64.tar.gz
        asset_name: a2a-scanner-macos-arm64.tar.gz
        asset_content_type: application/gzip

    - name: Update Homebrew formula
      run: |
        git clone https://${{ secrets.HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN }}@github.com/cisco-ai-defense/homebrew-ai-defense.git
        cd homebrew-ai-defense
        git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
        git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
        
        # Get version from pyproject.toml
        VERSION=$(grep -E "^version\s*=" ../pyproject.toml | cut -d'"' -f2)
        
        # Calculate SHA256
        SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 ../dist/a2a-scanner-macos-arm64.tar.gz | cut -d' ' -f1)
        
        # Update formula
        sed -i '' "s/version \".*\"/version \"$VERSION\"/" Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
        sed -i '' "s/sha256 \".*\"/sha256 \"$SHA256\"/" Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
        
        git add Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
        git commit -m "Update a2a-scanner to version $VERSION"
        git push origin main
